What should we do if we consistiently get the error "loadcell data are noisy, make sure the printer is on a stable surface." It's on a marble countertop, I'm not sure what more stable of a surface I could hope for?
The QR code provided points to a guide that only seems to describe the screws to check on the nextruder, with little mention of INDX. It seems the only option is to contact support?
